title: Woody Guthrie at 100! Live at the Kennedy Center
original_title: Woody Guthrie at 100! Live at the Kennedy Center
overview: Celebrate the centennial of Woody Guthrie's birthday with John Mellencamp, Jackson Browne, Tom Morello, Donovan, Ani DiFranco, Rosanne Cash, The Old Crow Medicine Show and more. Recorded live at the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts in Washington, DC, this concert honors the music of America's great folk singer.
